side_notes: Coverage skew toward figurative/metaphor (3 agents x same apparatus/war chest/clock instances) and self-referential meta-commentary (3 agents x same 'deserves note'/'recorded here' pair) — the same two or three source sentences are re-flagged repeatedly, so breadth of distinct devices is narrower than the finding count suggests.

All findings operate at sentence/clause level (sentence length, clause-stacking, nominalization, diction, metaphor). Paragraph-level architecture — ordering of paragraphs within 2.3/2.4/2.5, topic-sentence placement, and whether whole paragraphs are longer/denser than exemplar paragraphs — is unexamined by all three agents.

Section 2.1 prose itself is not directly sampled; our_quotes draw only from 2.3, 2.4, 2.5 (with 2.1 referenced via callbacks). Whether the originating 2.1 passages show the same complexity gap is uncovered.

redteam_rejected.reason: Direction/evidence not supported: the exemplar quotes (bushee 'only requirement for identification is changes in CEO characteristics', hollander 're-estimate equation (1)...CEOs in office at least one year') are not lighter or more parenthetical cross-references than our quotes; they are substantive content sentences, not a low-cross-reference baseline. The pairing does not demonstrate that our prose threads MORE inline pointers than the exemplar register for the same job, so the stated complexity gap is not established by the evidence offered.
